headline: Nvidia Personnel Storm Drags Down Asian Stocks; Taiwan Shares Fall 6%, Japan and Korea Also Slump | Securities
summary: Asian stock markets mostly fell, with Taiwan shares down 6% and Japan and Korea also slumping. Investors are focused on AI-related stocks ahead of Nvidia's earnings report this week.
why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, and its shares are a major driver of global tech and semiconductor valuations. Taiwan's and Korea's markets carry heavy exposure to chip supply chains.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: The departure of the CEO is the triggering event for the tech sell-off described in the input.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Tech stocks remained under pressure after the departure of Nvidia's CEO, according to the report. Investors are also watching Nvidia's earnings this week and Anthropic's planned stock market listing.
